modelAnswer: The Golgi apparatus consists of stacks of flattened membrane sacs.

items.followUp: Name two endangered species found in Pakistan and state one threat faced by each.

rubric.why: An endangered species is at risk of extinction, commonly because its population has become very small or declined.
rubric.description: Defines endangered species in terms of risk of extinction.
rubric.how: Award 2 marks for a clear definition that includes risk of extinction.

rubric.why: The Indus river dolphin is an endangered freshwater species found in the Indus River.
rubric.description: Names one endangered species in Pakistan and gives a relevant identifying fact or habitat.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming the Indus river dolphin and identifying its Indus River or freshwater habitat.

rubric.why: The snow leopard lives in the high mountains of northern Pakistan.
rubric.description: Names a second endangered species and gives its habitat or a relevant fact.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming the snow leopard and giving its mountain habitat or northern Pakistan location.

rubric.why: The markhor is a wild goat found in Pakistan's mountainous regions.
rubric.description: Names a third endangered species and gives its habitat or a relevant fact.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming the markhor and identifying it as a wild goat or giving its mountainous habitat.

modelAnswer: Endangered species are species whose populations have become so small that they are at risk of extinction.
The Indus river dolphin is an endangered freshwater dolphin found in the Indus River; dams and reduced river flow threaten it.
The snow leopard lives in the high mountains of northern Pakistan and is threatened by habitat loss and hunting.
The markhor is a wild goat of Pakistan's mountainous regions; habitat loss and illegal hunting threaten its population.

items.followUp: Name the main proteins in blood plasma and give one function of plasma.

rubric.why: Plasma is the straw-coloured liquid component of blood.
rubric.description: Identifies the appearance and nature of plasma.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for describing plasma as the straw-coloured or pale-yellow liquid part of blood.

rubric.why: Water makes up the major part of plasma, about 90%.
rubric.description: States the water content of plasma.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that plasma is mainly water or about 90% water.

rubric.why: Albumin, globulins and fibrinogen are the main plasma proteins.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming the principal plasma proteins.

rubric.why: Plasma transports dissolved substances and also contributes to clotting and defence.
rubric.description: Gives a correct function of plasma or one of its components.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a correct function, such as transport, clotting or defence.

modelAnswer: Blood plasma is the straw-coloured liquid component of blood and makes up about 55% of its volume.
It consists mainly of water (about 90%), with dissolved substances including nutrients, salts, hormones and waste products.
Its main proteins are albumin, globulins and fibrinogen.
Plasma transports dissolved substances; fibrinogen helps blood clot, while antibodies in plasma help defend the body.
